title: Cut from her grad photo, now he's the investor
description: Nate sold his car to pay his girlfriend's tuition, and on graduation day she cuts him out of her photo and dumps him. A new wordless montage shows him trading on fomo up to a $2,460,000 balance, so three years later he's her new boyfriend's investor and springs the trap in his office. The live-action tag at the end becomes Nate saying fomo's end line.
text:
SCENE 1 — EXT. CAMPUS LAWN — GRADUATION DAY — GOLDEN HOUR
The girl, in a black graduation gown and cap, poses for a photographer; Nate steps up beside her holding a big bouquet.
PHOTOGRAPHER: Boyfriend in the picture too?
GIRL: No, just me.
Her friend, also in a gown and cap, leans in, eyebrows up.
FRIEND: Wait, didn't he pay for your school?
The girl hisses through clenched teeth, glancing sideways.
GIRL: Can you not tell people that?
Nate freezes, the bouquet at his chest.
NATE: Seriously?
She turns her back on him to pose; Nate stands apart, the bouquet lowered.
SCENE 2 — FLASHBACK — EXT. EMPTY ROAD — SUNSET — TWO YEARS EARLIER
Nate drops his car keys into a buyer's open palm.
Nate stands on the empty road as his old car drives off into the low sun.
At the kitchen table, Nate tips out his wallet: a few coins.
SCENE 3 — FLASHBACK — INT. SMALL KITCHEN — NIGHT
The girl, in a light-blue floral slip dress, comes in holding up her phone; Nate sits at the table with a glass of water.
GIRL: You really did this?
NATE: You said this was your dream.
She throws her arms around him; their foreheads nearly touch.
NATE: When I make it, we make it.
SCENE 4 — EXT. CAMPUS LAWN — GRADUATION DAY
White flash: back at graduation, she hugs Nate and takes the bouquet, then steps back and looks him over, camera flashes popping behind her.
GIRL: You don't fit where I'm going.
NATE: After everything?
Nate walks away down an aisle of cheering graduates, the bouquet hanging from his hand.
SCENE 5 — MONTAGE — NATE'S ROOM — NIGHTS
Nate, alone at a cheap desk in a dark room, picks up his phone; his face lights blue.
★ fomo screen: Token chart down — on Nate's phone, a red day
Nate's head drops, then he sits back up and keeps going.
Another night: the clock past 3 a.m., Nate scrolling charts, a cold coffee beside him.
★ fomo screen: Token chart up — on Nate's phone, his first small win, the position reads +$52 (+3.4%)
Another late night: rain on the window, Nate rubbing his eyes, still trading.
★ fomo screen: Token chart up — on Nate's phone, the balance reads $6,140
★ fomo screen: Token chart up — on Nate's phone, the balance reads $48,300
★ fomo screen: Home (rich) — on Nate's phone, the balance reads $2,460,000
Nate, now in a navy suit, straightens his tie in a mirror with a small smirk.
SCENE 6 — INT. PENTHOUSE PARTY — SUNSET — THREE YEARS LATER
The girl, in a sparkly blue slip dress, stands with her new boyfriend; he spots someone and lights up.
NEW BOYFRIEND: There he is.
He walks over to Nate (navy suit and tie, plain navy cap, gold-tinted glasses, iced watch) and shakes his hand.
NEW BOYFRIEND: Mr. Nate, thank you for meeting me.
Close on the girl, eyes wide.
GIRL: You know him?
NEW BOYFRIEND: He's the investor I told you about.
NATE: We'll talk tomorrow, of course.
Nate walks past her without a look.
SCENE 7 — EXT. PENTHOUSE BALCONY — NIGHT
The girl and Nate, now in a cream knit tee and chains, stand at the glass rail over the city lights.
GIRL: I made the wrong choice.
NATE: What about him?
GIRL: He can't give me the life I thought he could.
GIRL: I should have chose you.
Nate stares at her, slow blink, looks down, then walks back inside.
NATE: Come to my office tomorrow.
Her hurt look turns into a sly smile.
SCENE 8 — INT. NATE'S OFFICE — DAY
She walks in and rushes to hug Nate.
GIRL: You meant it.
GIRL: So it was true.
The camera pulls back as she lets go: her new boyfriend sits at the glass boardroom table behind them.
GIRL: You set me up?
Nate turns to camera with a small smirk and holds up his phone.
★ fomo screen: Home (rich) — on Nate's phone held to camera, the balance reads $2,460,000
NATE: Want to trade like me? Download fomo through the link in my bio.

cast.role: Nate, the boyfriend who paid her tuition
cast.description: Late teens, tan skin, big brown eyes, dark curly hair. Before: navy cap worn backwards, plain white tee, silver chain, black baggy jeans, white sneakers. After: navy suit and tie or a cream knit tee with chunky chains and a big round pendant, plain navy cap, gold-tinted rimless glasses, iced watch.

Early 20s, long caramel-blonde hair. Black graduation gown and cap at the photo; light-blue floral slip dress in the flashback; sparkly blue slip dress at the party and on the balcony; light grey slip dress at the office.
Early 20s, dark hair, black graduation gown and cap, curious raised eyebrows.
Late 20s, tall, slicked dark hair, white linen shirt and trousers.
